title: Compagnie Generale de Geophysique - proposed acquisition of Veritas DGC Inc

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Compagnie Generale de Geophysique - proposed acquisition of Veritas DGC Inc
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not need to conclusively define the relevant markets for this matter.  It therefore adopted narrowly defined separate national markets for the supply of: - marine seismic data acquisition services; and - seismic data processing services. Adopting markets with a wider product dimension would not have changed the ACCC's conclusion on whether the proposed acquisition would raise competition concerns.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to raise competition concerns given the number of existing competitors in the relevant markets; evidence of new entrants in recent years; and the use of competitive tender processes by customers (typically gas and oil companies).
